mapper.select: select * from department order by department_id;
select * from doctor_exp where department_id = #{departmentId} and status = 0;

select de.doctor_id, de.department_id, de.real_name, de.gender, de.doctor_title, de.outpatient_type, de.avatar, de.fee, ds.schedule_id, sum(ss.max_number) as max_number, sum(ss.remain_number) as remain_number from doctor_exp de join doctor_schedule ds on de.doctor_id = ds.doctor_id join schedule_slot ss on ds.schedule_id = ss.schedule_id where de.department_id = #{departmentId} and de.status = 0 and ds.work_date = str_to_date(#{workDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by de.doctor_id, ds.schedule_id

select d.department_id as selectDepartmentId, d.name as selectDepartmentName, d.description, pd.name as parentDepartmentName from department d left join department pd on d.parent_id = pd.department_id where d.department_id = #{departmentId}

select de.avatar, de.real_name, de.doctor_title, de.specialty, de.description, de.fee, d.name as departmentName, ds.work_date as appointmentDate from doctor_schedule ds join doctor_exp de on ds.doctor_id = de.doctor_id join department d on de.department_id = d.department_id where ds.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and de.status = 0 and ds.status = 0
select ss.period, count(*) as remainNumber from schedule_slot ss where ss.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and status = 'available' group by period
select ss.slot_id, ss.schedule_id, ss.period, ss.seq_no, ss.display_no, ss.fee, ss.status from schedule_slot ss where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and period = #{period}
